lines.en: My six legs run very fast
I scurry flat along the grass

lines.zh: 我绕着你脚边转了一圈
lines.en: I dart once around your feet
My shell scrapes the grass
I pause and probe with my feelers
I hop onto a stone and back down
I follow two steps behind you
My claws take the ground lightly
I sidle a few steps
I squeeze through a narrow gap
I dive into the leaf pile and come out
I run your way
I run the length of the wall's base

lines.zh: 我停一下，看看你在不在
lines.en: I stop to check you're still there

lines.zh: 我爬到你靴子上再下来
lines.en: I climb your boot and drop off
I slip through a fence gap
I lie down at your feet
My shell shines in the light
I look up at you and wait
I tuck my legs under me

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方有响动
lines.en: I hear something far off
My compound eyes shift
I nudge up against your hand
I'm small, but quick
I'm watching the corner

lines.zh: 我抖了抖背上的一片壳
lines.en: I shake a plate on my back
I wait for you to say we're going
The sun's warm; I shift

lines.zh: 我抬头，六只眼一起看你
lines.en: I look up, all six eyes on you
You crouched down; you're still so tall
I know your footsteps

lines.zh: 我的触须碰到你的手指
lines.en: My feelers touch your finger
You'll take me along, won't you
I've climbed onto your arm
Your shoulder is a good spot
I bob my head at you
You don't shoo me, so I won't go
We're on the same side
Pressed close, I hear your heart
Sit down and I'll climb up

lines.zh: 我把六条腿都收进壳底
lines.en: I tuck all six legs under my shell

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，赶紧爬起来
lines.en: I roll over and scramble up
A seam splits across my back plate
I retreat behind your feet
My feelers droop
I shake my six legs
I don't cry out; I only scurry faster
I hide in the leaves

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，像在问怎么办
lines.en: I look up at you as if asking what to do
I grind my mouthparts
That thing in your hand; let me see
I'm not picky; anything works
I reach with a claw and can't
Just lower it a bit
Let me have a sniff first
That's not enough for me
I hug it, and no one takes it
There's a faint sweetness
There's still a smell on your hand
I'm taking it; thanks
I circle it twice
Hold it steady; don't drop it
You kick me aside
I scurry clear before I'm stepped on
Your boot hits my back
I dart between your legs
I get squeezed and roll over
I cling to the rim of your boot.
Your boot missed me by half an inch
We bump and I spring away
I press against your boot
I'm up again already

lines.zh: 另一只从石头后面爬出来
lines.en: Another climbs out from behind a stone
We touch feelers
It's a little smaller than me
We run circles around the stone
It taps my back twice
We lie side by side in the sun
It steals half my bug
I don't mind; it's smaller
Its shell is brighter than mine
From now on we both follow you
I hold it down with a foreleg
It's a bit bigger than me; funny
I drag it; it's heavy
I hug it and run
I drop it and pick it up again
I sniff it; not edible
I hide it under a stone
This one's for you
I roll it to your feet
Into my little nest it goes
Something's close; I arch my back
I plant myself between you and it
My feelers stand up
I know this smell, and it's bad
I bite its leg
Stand back; leave it to me
I'm smaller than it, but not scared
I circle it, hunting a gap
It moves and so do I
I'm ready to leap
It's much bigger than me
I flatten myself right down
I bite and will not let go
It shakes me; I grip harder
I slip around its flank

lines.zh: 我的触须在探它哪里软
lines.en: My feelers test where it's soft
I've jumped onto its back

lines.zh: 它转过来找我，我躲开了
lines.en: It turns to find me; I'm gone
I wait for its opening

lines.zh: 我的爪子扎进它的缝里
lines.en: My claws dig into its seam
I bite its joint
I fall off and climb back on
It's bleeding; I smell it
I snap in once more
I leap and bite its leg
My claws open a line
The bite twists it off balance
That bite catches nothing
I kick up its shell to climb
I bite its tendril
My legs tangle its legs
I leap onto its back plate
I bite its belly from below
It slams me against a stone

lines.zh: 我从不远的石缝里钻出来
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crevice nearby

lines.zh: 我探头看了看，就爬过来了
lines.en: I peek out, then scurry over

lines.zh: 我的壳在草丛里反了一下光
lines.en: My shell flashes once in the grass
All six feet land together
I'm small, and so is my voice
I look up at you, interested
I pass by your feet
My feelers come out first
I stop on a stone a moment
I run over to your side
The burn makes me jump

lines.zh: 我从石头上掉下来，壳先着地
lines.en: I fall off the stone, shell first
Water covers me and my legs thrash
The blast blows me far
A small arrow pins my shell

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的腿发麻
lines.en: That force numbs my legs
Hunger makes my shell feel light
The thunder sends me into a crevice
Nothing below; my claws can't hold
